data.title: Raised ApoB comes from diet
data.thesis: Noa's ApoB is high mainly because of saturated fat in the diet, so changing the diet will bring it to target.

data.title: Raised ApoB is mostly inherited
data.thesis: Noa's ApoB stays high on a careful diet because of an inherited tendency, so it needs medication to reach target.

data.title: Tiredness comes from low iron stores

data.title: The raised TSH of July 2025 was a one-off
data.thesis: The TSH of 4.6 in July 2025 was a transient rise, not the start of an underactive thyroid.
